title: Predicting Preclinical Cognitive Decline Using Plasma P-tau217 and APOE Genotype in 8,582 Individuals From Different Ethnic Groups.
justification: The study evaluates the association between plasma P-tau217 levels and cognitive impairment in a large cohort of individuals, making it an observational cohort study rather than a randomized controlled trial or case-control study.

title: Real world clinical practice of lecanemab at PUMCH dementia cohort: focus on dynamic imaging and biomarker evolution.

title: Peripheral inflammation in a Canadian cohort of neurodegenerative conditions: Occurrence, determinants, and impact.
justification: The study assesses blood inflammatory markers in a cohort of older adults, comparing those with cognitive impairment to cognitively normal individuals, which fits the definition of a cohort study. It does not involve randomization or control groups typical of RCTs.

title: Estimated Effects of Comorbidities on Risk of All-cause Dementia in Patients with Mild Cognitive Impairment.
justification: The study is a retrospective cohort study analyzing the effects of comorbidities on the risk of all-cause dementia in patients with mild cognitive impairment, which fits the criteria for Level 3 evidence.
